description: Swipe to confirm (9.22.0, «Button.confirm: 'swipe'», «x-swipeConfirm»). Written by hand; one table for every reader. Numbers are logical points from the inline START of the button (the right edge in right-to-left scripts). «dx» is the pointer movement on the screen, positive to the right. «keyboardCases» and «pressCases» say what each way of pressing does; the readers check them on their real button.

geometryCases.name: lg button 48 high, 345 wide, a 1 border, inset xs = 4: the thumb is 38, the label strip is between its two places
md button 40 high, 200 wide, no border
a track of 56 with a 1 border (own padding): the thumb follows the height
a track narrower than the thumb and its inset: no travel, the gesture never acts

naturalWidthCases.name: a label of 120 in an lg track with a 1 border: label plus the thumb room on both sides; the inline padding of the size is not read
an empty label: two thumb rooms

progressCases.name: half the travel to the right, left to right
right to left: the end of the line is on the left, so moving left is progress
right to left: moving right is backwards

releaseCases.name: released at the threshold — the action
released a hair before the threshold — the thumb returns, nothing happens
released at the end — the action
released without moving — the thumb stays, nothing happens
a disabled button never acts, wherever it is released

thumbCases.name: at rest: the border and the inset from the start
at the end: the inset from the end border

captureCases.name: mostly along the line — the drag is captured
mostly across — the body scrolls, the thumb does not move
backwards along the line is still along it

pressCases.name: a pointer press without moving does nothing
a drag released past the threshold acts once, the track event first
a drag released before the threshold does nothing
a held Enter repeating is not a press
Enter on a disabled button does nothing
a drag on a disabled button does not move the thumb and does nothing

schemaCases.name: a word the contract does not have
the field is not part of the icon button

ruleCases.name: the threshold is nine tenths of the travel
the thumb stands the xs step inside the border
the thumb is the background of the role
the drag goes from the inline start to the inline end
from the keyboard it is an ordinary button
assistive technology activates it at once
a pointer press without the drag does nothing
a disabled button does not move
after the action the thumb returns
